newsitem.title: UK: UK windfall tax size still decided - Labour.
newsitem.headline: UK windfall tax size still decided - Labour.

text.p: The opposition Labour Party will not decide how much it will raise from a one-off tax on privatised utilities until after it is in power, finance spokesman Gordon Brown said on Thursday.
"This is a matter that will be decided in government. It is a matter which will have to be decided after consultation with the regulator," Brown said at a press conference.
"It will be decided after listening to the interested parties putting their views," he said.

Asked to comment on newspaper reports that he wanted the tax to raise below 5.0 billion stg, Labour leader Tony Blair said "In principle, as Gordon has just said, these are decisions that have to be taken by the Chancellor in government and that is what will happen."
Labour has a commanding lead over the ruling Conservative Party in the opinion polls ahead of the May 1 election.
